benefit_text: Farmers get subsidies of 50 to 80 percent when they buy agricultural machinery, making the equipment cheaper. The scheme also promotes custom hiring centres and develops hubs for high‑tech farm equipment, helping farmers work faster and increase yield.
who_can_apply: All landholding farmers and their families, SHGs, user groups, cooperative societies, FPOs and entrepreneurs can apply. The farmer must be a native of India and financially weak. Women farmers get priority and anyone who has not taken another central subsidy earlier can apply.
documents: Aadhar card, Record of Right of land, copy of first page of bank pass book, passport size photo, any ID proof such as Driving licence or Voter ID.
how_to_apply: Visit the portal agrimachinery.nic.in, choose the registration option, fill the form with correct district, block and personal details, and submit the application online.
